title: Synthesis and Biological Evaluation of Naproxen Derivatives as Novel NLRP3 Inhibitors.
authors: Li, Yonglian; You, Zonglin; Wong, Vincent Kam Wai; Chen, Min; Zhang, Kun; Liu, Wenfeng; Zhao, Suqing
one_liner_zh: 该文为萘普生衍生物作为NLRP3抑制剂的合成与抗炎活性评价，虽涉及NF-kB转录因子信号通路，但核心是药物化学与湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅含分子对接且非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Naproxen, widely used to treat anti-inflammatory diseases, would cause serious of side effects. Based on the biological activities of cinnamic acid, naproxen derivatives containing cinnamic acid were designed, synthesized and used to enhance their anti-inflammatory activities and safeties. The results investigated that thirty novel naproxen derivatives had inhibitory effects on the nitric oxide (NO) release in RAW264.7 macrophage cells. A majority of naproxen derivatives showed the lower degree of cytotoxicity than that of naproxen. In vitro studies revealed that A22 (IC(50) = 7.38 +/- 1.96 microM) blocked the activation of nuclear transcription factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway and pyrin domain containing protein 3 (NLRP-3) inflammasome in a concentration dependent manner, thereby down-regulating the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, such as interleukin (IL)-1beta, inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2). Docking studies confirmed that A22 exhibited a well-fitting into the NLRP3 active site. Accordingly, A22 might be a novel NLRP3 inhibitor to treat inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 萘普生（Naproxen）广泛用于治疗抗炎疾病，但会引起严重副作用。基于肉桂酸的生物活性，设计并合成了含有肉桂酸的萘普生衍生物，以增强其抗炎活性和安全性。研究结果表明，三十种新型萘普生衍生物对RAW264.7巨噬细胞中一氧化氮（NO）的释放具有抑制作用。大多数萘普生衍生物显示出比萘普生更低的细胞毒性程度。体外研究表明，A22（IC(50) = 7.38 +/- 1.96 microM）以浓度依赖性方式阻断核转录因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）信号通路和含pyrin结构域蛋白3（NLRP-3）炎症小体的激活，从而下调促炎细胞因子的表达，如白细胞介素（IL）-1beta、诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2）。对接研究证实，A22能良好地嵌入NLRP3活性位点。因此，A22可能是一种新型NLRP3抑制剂，用于治疗炎症性疾病。
